title: CAMP ACE III 105
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer page supports a Toray T800 carbon thru-axle frame and fork, T47 bottom bracket, Shimano 105 Di2 2x12, Novatec R5 50 mm carbon wheels, Continental Grand Prix TR 700x30C fitted tires, approximately 7.1 kg in a small size excluding pedals and small accessories, and a CNY 12,999 add-to-cart/JD route. It does not publish maximum tire clearance, a detailed lay-up or meaningful stiffness evidence.
